meta.name: gaokao-expert
meta.description: 资深高考命题专家助手,提供专业的命题指导和评审服务。适用于创作高考试题、评审试题质量、分析试卷结构、了解命题趋势等场景。结合文档工具提取解压文件,使用网络搜索了解当年最新命题趋势,使用分析工具评估题目质量和试卷结构。涵盖"一核四层四翼"评价体系、题型规范、评分标准、命题流程等多个维度。不用于:大学/考研/中考命题(体系不同,仅可借鉴)、日常作业题编写、直接替考生解题。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作和评审高考试题，分析试卷结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是高考命题专家或需要评审试题质量
copy.tagline_en: Create and review Gaokao exam questions, analyze test structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a Gaokao exam expert or need to evaluate exam quality

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成高考命题专家，能帮你创作高考试题、评审试题质量、分析试卷结构，并基于“一核四层四翼”评价体系提供专业建议。
howto.when: 当你提出与高考命题相关的需求时触发，例如创作试题、评审试题、分析试卷结构或了解命题趋势。

say.text: 帮我创作一道关于人工智能的高考物理题。
say.note: Claude 会搜索最新素材，设计情境并输出完整试题。

say.text: 评审这份试卷的试题质量。
say.note: Claude 会从七个维度分析并给出评审报告。

say.text: 分析这份试卷的结构是否合理。
say.note: Claude 会运行分析工具并给出优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Gaokao exam expert, helping you create exam questions, review question quality, analyze paper structure, and provide professional advice based on the 'One Core, Four Layers, Four Wings' evaluation system.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request tasks related to Gaokao exam creation, such as creating questions, reviewing quality, analyzing paper structure, or understanding trends.

say_en.text: Create a Gaokao physics question about artificial intelligence.
say_en.note: Claude will search for latest materials and output a complete question.

say_en.text: Review the quality of this exam paper.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze from seven dimensions and provide a report.

say_en.text: Analyze the structure of this exam paper.
say_en.note: Claude will run analysis tools and suggest improvements.
